liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (5 reviews): The reviewer's companion said she had now gotten her Dark Star; After it, the band seems to start heading into St. Stephen, according to the reviewer [26][27][28][29][33]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): In the tune-up, Phil can be heard urging Althea as opener, but Bob chose Stranger [32]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): By this song the band is settled into a rolling groove [25]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The China Cat into Rider pairing is named among the highlights, alongside Althea and Ramble On Rose [27]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): Builds steadily until Bobby shouts at full force [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-09-20.schoeps.wiley.11633.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 179 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Digital pops removed in Tunning and Truckin', plus a dropout removed in Truckin' [1]
- **gd1990-09-20.schoepsmk4.bratman.9989.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 180 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1990-09-20.150669.nak300.boedicker.flac1644**: source not stated; 21 songs; 168 min [4]
- **gd90-09-20.sbd.ashley.14855.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 180 min; rated 4.77/5 by 48 [5]. Said about its sound: Sound quality rated excellent, though there is a lot of synthetic thunder sound; Reviewer's analog-era audience copy is bright and clear, with music, vocals and the loud crowd all audible; Reviewer calls the archive copy pristine and killer-sounding [24][31][32]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says this was among Bruce's first shows with the band, though it doesn't sound it [23]
- Reviewer hears Bruce lost on the material in places, as if unfamiliar with Playin' [24]
- Band was eager for this Garden run with new members Vince and Bruce, and put in real effort [25]
- Vince's synth is intrusive in the opening songs, then he tones it down [25]
- Reviewer says the Garden shook more than ever that night [28]
- Closing night of the Madison Square Garden run, with two new members in the band [29]
- Reviewer notes strong interplay between the band and the crowd in the second set [31]
- Reviewer sat in the first bowl on Phil's side and saw him sipping from a red cup [32]
- Less perfunctory and corporate than most late-era shows, partly because of Bruce's unfamiliarity [24]
- Reviewer calls it the best show they saw in the final stage of the band's career [27]
- Among roughly sixty shows the reviewer saw, this ranks near the top [33]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-09-20.schoeps.wiley.11633.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Dave Brotman; transferred by Tim Wiley; source: FOB-AUD(Scheops)>DAT>CDR> [1]
- **gd1990-09-20.schoepsmk4.bratman.9989.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Darrin Sacks; source: Recorded by Dave Bratman FOB DFC, (Section 2, row 15, seat 1) Schoeps MK4/CMC3 (ortf/110deg)>Oade PS>Oade Mod. SV255 (MIT reference XLR interconnects). [3]. Also: Secondary source is a Healy soundboard/audience ultramix, used to patch Truckin' at two spots [3]
- **gd1990-09-20.150669.nak300.boedicker.flac1644**: taped by Taped By Dave Boedicker,Official Taper Section.; transferred by Dave Boedicker; source: Nakamichi 300 Mics W/CP4 Shotguns>Sony WM-D6C Cassette Deck>1 TDM MA-90 Metal Cassette Tape(1stSet) And 1 100 Minute [4]. Also: Tape flips after Ramble On Rose and Throwing Stones clipped the first seconds of the following songs [4]
- **gd90-09-20.sbd.ashley.14855.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]. Also: Reviewer holds an audience copy from the analog days but has no source information for it; This is a remaster of the original soundboard DSBD source [5][31]

## Art and photos

- Poster by wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead Madison Square Garden](https://wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com/2021/05/grateful-dead-madison-square-garden.html) [38]

claims.text: Builds steadily until Bobby shouts at full force
Reviewer says this was among Bruce's first shows with the band, though it doesn't sound it
Reviewer hears Bruce lost on the material in places, as if unfamiliar with Playin'
Less perfunctory and corporate than most late-era shows, partly because of Bruce's unfamiliarity
Sound quality rated excellent, though there is a lot of synthetic thunder sound
Band was eager for this Garden run with new members Vince and Bruce, and put in real effort
Vince's synth is intrusive in the opening songs, then he tones it down
By this song the band is settled into a rolling groove
The reviewer's companion said she had now gotten her Dark Star
Reviewer calls it the best show they saw in the final stage of the band's career
After it, the band seems to start heading into St. Stephen, according to the reviewer
The China Cat into Rider pairing is named among the highlights, alongside Althea and Ramble On Rose
Reviewer says the Garden shook more than ever that night
Felt as if the band might tear the old building down
Closing night of the Madison Square Garden run, with two new members in the band
Roughly six minutes before the first verse, then goes far out after a Vince-led segue through the Playin' reprise
Reviewer notes strong interplay between the band and the crowd in the second set
Reviewer's analog-era audience copy is bright and clear, with music, vocals and the loud crowd all audible
Reviewer holds an audience copy from the analog days but has no source information for it
Reviewer sat in the first bowl on Phil's side and saw him sipping from a red cup
In the tune-up, Phil can be heard urging Althea as opener, but Bob chose Stranger
Reviewer calls the archive copy pristine and killer-sounding
The reprise builds relentlessly while Bruce pounds the piano harder, an unforgettable moment for the reviewer
Reviewer was on the Garden floor and shouted to a friend that he was going to fall
Among roughly sixty shows the reviewer saw, this ranks near the top
Digital pops removed in Tunning and Truckin', plus a dropout removed in Truckin'
Tapers befriended the head security guard and ran a copy for him each night
Secondary source is a Healy soundboard/audience ultramix, used to patch Truckin' at two spots
Tape flips after Ramble On Rose and Throwing Stones clipped the first seconds of the following songs
This is a remaster of the original soundboard DSBD source
